english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for comforting someone who is grieving, disappointed, or upset.

exampleSentences.english: I stayed with them all night to console them.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我陪住佢，安慰咗佢一晚。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 pui4 zyu6 keoi5 on1 wai3 zo2 keoi5 jat1 maan5

english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on comforting someone emotionally rather than calming them physically or behaviourally.

exampleSentences.english: They were heartbroken, so I chatted with them to soothe them.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢失戀，我陪佢傾偈安慰佢。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 ngo5 pui4 keoi5 king1 gai2 on1 wai3 keoi5

english.note: Choose this when cheer means offering comfort or consolation to someone who is upset.

exampleSentences.english: I went to cheer up my friend after a breakup.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我去安慰下失戀嘅朋友。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 on1 wai3 haa5 sat1 lyun2 ge3 pang4 jau5
